Fit a SIMP model

fit.Rd

Run Bayesian inference on a SIMP model specification using the NUTS sampler.

Usage

fit(
  model,
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = NULL,
  thin = 1,
  cores = 1,
  seed = NULL,
  init = "random",
  max_treedepth = 10,
  adapt_delta = 0.8,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

model

A simp_model object created by simp()

chains

Number of MCMC chains (default 4)

iter

Number of sampling iterations per chain (default 2000)

warmup

Number of warmup iterations per chain (default half of iter)

thin

Thinning interval (default 1, no thinning)

cores

Number of cores for parallel chains (default 1)

seed

Random seed for reproducibility

init

Initialization method: "random" (default), "zero", or a list of initial values

max_treedepth

Maximum tree depth for NUTS (default 10)

adapt_delta

Target acceptance rate (default 0.8)

verbose

Print progress (default TRUE)

Value

A simp_fit object containing posterior samples and diagnostics

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Create model
model <- simp(cover ~ temp + (1 | site), data = dat)

# Fit model
fit <- fit(model, chains = 4, iter = 2000)

# Examine results
summary(fit)
} # }
